title: Cambridge IELTS 12 Test 7 Writing Task 1
directions: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.
prompt: The chart below shows how frequently people in the USA ate in fast food restaurants between 2003 and 2013.
scenario: The chart compares the frequency with which people in the USA ate at fast food restaurants in 2003, 2006 and 2013.
requirements: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

visualData.title: Frequency of eating at fast food restaurants among people in the USA (2003–2013)
notes: Horizontal categories: Every day; Several times a week; Once a week; Once or twice a month; A few times a year; Never.
